bluf: Father's Day Sunday — heavy hotel occupancy and the largest event of the Juneteenth weekend: 5 Seconds of Summer at Moody Center (~15,000 capacity, 8 PM, 1.1 mi NE). Louis Tomlinson is confirmed at Dickies Arena in Fort Worth — NOT Austin tonight. Heat index reaching 106–109°F along the I-35 corridor — no Heat Advisory issued yet but NWS monitoring closely for Monday. Drying weather pattern today after overnight storms. E. Riverside robbery-homicide suspect remains at large (no new arrest). US-Iran technical implementation talks actively underway in Switzerland today — Strait of Hormuz dispute ongoing but ceasefire holding.

incidents.title: E. Riverside AutoZone Robbery-Homicide (SUSPECT AT LARGE)
incidents.location: 2237 East Riverside Dr, SE Austin (~2.5 mi SE)
incidents.detail: Jose Salgado-Amador, 28, shot and killed June 15 during apparent robbery while working as mechanic in AutoZone parking lot. Suspect: Hispanic male, 15–20 yrs, gray hoodie, fled in light-colored sedan. APD released surveillance video June 18. No arrest as of this brief. Austin's 27th homicide of 2026. $1,000 reward. Suspect description and MO (opportunistic robbery, parking lot) warrants continued exterior staff awareness. Brief valet and loading dock teams. No confirmed link to downtown but elevated posture maintained.

incidents.title: SE Austin Homicide Cluster — Ongoing Investigations
incidents.detail: APD confirmed June 18 no connection found between 3 homicides in 3 consecutive days (June 15–17). Actively searching for suspects in 2 of 3 cases. Francesca Ortiz ID'd as June 17 victim. Cases isolated — no pattern or broader threat to downtown. Monitoring only. No direct threat vector to property.

incidents.title: US-Iran Technical Talks — Switzerland (Active Today)
incidents.detail: US and Iranian delegations are in Switzerland today for technical implementation talks on the June 15 MoU — covering ceasefire terms, Strait of Hormuz reopening timeline, sanctions relief, and nuclear enrichment parameters. Tehran claims Hormuz remains closed; US disputes this. Al Jazeera: 'make-or-break' characterization. 60-day ceasefire window intact as of this brief. Low domestic protest risk today — no organized Austin events tied to Iran talks found. Monitor if talks collapse or IRGC hardliner faction acts publicly.

civil_unrest.title: Father's Day — Low Unrest Profile
civil_unrest.detail: No organized protests or demonstrations identified in Austin for June 21. Father's Day typically generates family-oriented crowds — restaurants, parks, waterfront venues. Carver Kickback (Juneteenth edition) concluded yesterday. No civil unrest indicators downtown.

civil_unrest.title: US-Iran Protest Watch — Reduced
civil_unrest.detail: Lebanon-Hezbollah ceasefire holding. US-Iran 60-day MoU framework intact. Switzerland talks underway. Domestic protest risk LOW unless talks publicly collapse or new military action by either party. Austin ICE/anti-administration protest network quiet this weekend.

national_context: US-IRAN SWITZERLAND TALKS — DAY 1: Technical implementation round begins today. Witkoff (US) and Araghchi (Iran) delegations in Bern. Strait of Hormuz status disputed — Iran claims closure, US disputes. Al Jazeera: 'make-or-break' talks. 60-day MoU ceasefire window remains intact.
LEBANON-HEZBOLLAH CEASEFIRE: Framework holding as of this brief. Israel resumed limited airstrikes last week but ceasefire broadly intact. Monitor for escalation.
FIFA WORLD CUP 2026: Day 11 of group stage. Tournament driving elevated hotel occupancy and sports bar activity across Austin all month. Austin hosting matches at Q2 Stadium later in tournament.

HEAT WAVE BUILDING — CENTRAL TEXAS: NWS Austin forecasting mid-to-upper 90s Mon–Fri with heat indices 108–112°F. Heat Advisory expected Monday. Week-long elevated heat risk for outdoor staff and guests.
